output.summary: Most of Arts' resolution gap (about 70%) comes from SlotBook tickets routed to the P4 best-effort queue under RR-17. The rest is largely Lindqvist's twice-weekly on-site coverage, which also affects Education. Arts is not deprioritised like-for-like. Volume is not fully explained by SlotBook, and trivial or duplicate tickets are not the driver. Requesters got only a generic acknowledgement, so they were never told about the best-effort status. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unresolved. The only record is a meeting with no notes, and the other attendee declined to be interviewed. Whether the SSO migration raised SlotBook tickets is unestablished. Agree SlotBook support terms, fix the acknowledgement and report split by SlotBook. Defer decommissioning and the Arts desk transfer.
